answer: Attesting costs a haven of attention per epoch, and a forged echo collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Bright as a timber in fog, verified work is hard to counterfeit. Every epoch is an audition; skipping one quietly drains the credit you built. A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to small time-locked deposits refunded only after honest epochs, making fake identity expensive to sustain.
